<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Banco Mestre — Portal público V010 | Concursos</title>
<style>
:root{--ink:#162329;--muted:#586773;--line:#dce3e7;--bg:#f5f7f7;--paper:white;--accent:#174b54;--pale:#eaf2f1;--warn:#85591b;--shadow:0 4px 18px #1b30310d}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;font:15px/1.52 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg)}button,input,select{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}a{color:var(--accent);text-underline-offset:2px}button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #a1c9c7;outline-offset:2px}
.header{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:14px 24px;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20}.headinner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;max-width:1600px;margin:auto}.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;flex-shrink:0;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.3px}.logo{display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;width:35px;height:35px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:800}.topsearch{flex:1;max-width:580px;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;background:#f9fbfb}.topmeta{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-left:auto;white-space:nowrap}.wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:260px minmax(0,1fr);max-width:1600px;margin:auto;min-height:calc(100vh - 67px)}
.sidebar{background:#fff;border-right:1px solid var(--line);padding:22px 14px;position:sticky;top:67px;height:calc(100vh - 67px);overflow:auto}.groupLabel{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1.25px;color:#829098;padding:13px 12px 9px}.navbtn{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);text-align:left;width:100%;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 12px;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}.navbtn:hover,.navbtn.active{background:var(--pale);color:var(--accent)}.navbtn.active{font-weight:800}.navbtn span{white-space:normal}.navsmall{font-size:13px}.navcount{margin-left:auto;color:#81919a;font-size:12px}.folderrow{font-weight:700;border-top:1px solid #f1f3f4;margin-top:4px;font-size:12.5px}
.main{min-width:0;padding:34px clamp(18px,4vw,64px) 90px}.kicker{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.7px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent)}h1{font-size:clamp(27px,3.8vw,39px);line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-1.15px;margin:8px 0 15px}h2{font-size:21px;letter-spacing:-.5px;margin:0 0 12px}h3{font-size:16px;line-height:1.4;margin:0 0 8px}.desc{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:24px;max-width:820px}.statrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:25px 0 32px}.stat{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:17px}.stat b{display:block;font-size:29px;letter-spacing:-.8px}.stat small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.toolbar{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin:15px 0 19px}.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 11px;font-size:12px;background:#f1f4f4;color:#43545a}.btn{border:1px solid #cfd9dc;background:white;padding:9px 13px;border-radius:9px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}.btn:hover{background:var(--pale)}.btn.primary{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}.select{padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;background:#fff;max-width:100%}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:14px}.panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:19px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.panel.clickable{cursor:pointer}.panel.clickable:hover{border-color:#97b5b6;box-shadow:0 8px 24px #1b30311a}.panel p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:7px 0 0}.panel h3{margin-top:5px}.smallcaps{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.8px;color:#6f8187}.chapter{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;padding:14px 17px;margin-bottom:8px;background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;width:100%;justify-content:space-between}.chapter:hover{background:#f1f7f6}.chapter strong{display:block}.chapter small{display:block;color:var(--muted)}.chapter em{font-style:normal;color:#7d8d91;font-size:13px;flex-shrink:0}
.cardlist{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,310px),1fr));gap:14px}.fc{background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:20px;min-height:203px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}.fc-top{font-size:11px;color:#7d8a93;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-weight:800}.fc-question{font-weight:700;font-size:15px;white-space:pre-line;flex:1}.fc-answer{font-size:14px;white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.6}.revealed{background:#f1f7f4;border-radius:9px;padding:12px;border-left:3px solid var(--accent)}.minor{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);white-space:pre-line}.inlineActions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:7px}.centerEmpty{text-align:center;padding:48px;color:var(--muted);border:1px dashed #ccd5d8;border-radius:12px;background:white}.concept{margin-bottom:10px;border-left:3px solid #9db7bb;padding:12px 14px;background:#fff;border-radius:0 10px 10px 0}.concept .note{font-size:13px;white-space:pre-wrap}.concept .id{font-size:11px;color:var(--accent);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:3px}.atlas{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:14px}.imageCard{border:1px solid var(--line);background:white;border-radius:13px;overflow:hidden}.imageCard img{width:100%;height:172px;object-fit:contain;background:#fbfbfb;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.imageCard .icText{padding:13px}.imageCard h3{font-size:13px;min-height:36px;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;overflow:hidden}.imageCard p{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;margin:4px 0 10px}.sectionHead{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;margin:26px 0 12px;gap:12px}.sectionHead .right{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}.foot{margin-top:60px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#101c2299;z-index:60;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:15px}.dialog{max-width:900px;max-height:96vh;overflow:auto;width:100%;background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 22px 100px #0005}.dialog img{max-width:min(100%,680px);max-height:60vh;object-fit:contain;display:block;margin:12px auto;background:#fafafa;border:1px solid var(--line)}.dialoghead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}.close{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;width:35px;height:35px;border-radius:50%;font-size:19px}.linkIcon{display:inline-block;opacity:.75}.tagwarn{color:#805b26;background:#fff6e5}.metaLine{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0}.topmenu{display:none;border:0;background:#fff;font-size:22px;padding:0 4px}.mobileShut{display:none}
@media(max-width:880px){.wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}.sidebar{position:fixed;top:63px;left:0;bottom:0;width:min(84vw,320px);height:auto;z-index:35;box-shadow:6px 0 30px #0002;transform:translateX(-105%);transition:transform .18s}.sidebar.open{transform:translateX(0)}.topmenu{display:block}.topmeta{display:none}.main{padding:27px 20px 60px}.statrow{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.header{padding:13px 15px}.topsearch{min-width:0;width:100%}.brand strong{display:none}.mobileShut{display:block;float:right}.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(185px,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:520px){.header .headinner{gap:10px}.logo{height:32px;width:32px}.topsearch{padding:9px;font-size:13px}.statrow{gap:8px}.stat{padding:12px}.stat b{font-size:23px}.main{padding:24px 14px 55px}.panel{padding:15px}.fc{padding:15px}.atlas{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}.imageCard img{height:126px}.imageCard .icText{padding:10px}.imageCard h3{font-size:12px;min-height:30px}}
</style>
<style id="vigas01-styles">
.docreader {border:1px solid #dce3e7;border-radius:14px;background:white;padding:clamp(12px,3vw,32px);max-width:980px;margin:auto;overflow-x:auto}
.docreader img {max-width:100%!important;height:auto!important;display:block;margin:18px auto}
.docreader table {max-width:100%!important;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:0.95rem}
.docreader table td,.docreader table th {padding:6px;border:1px solid #d8dee1}
.docreader p,.docreader li {max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:break-word}
.docreader h1,.docreader h2,.docreader h3 {scroll-margin-top:90px}
@media(max-width:600px){.docreader{padding:14px}.docreader *{font-size:inherit;line-height:1.5}}
</style>
<style id="portal-v003-styles">
.docreader{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dae1e5;border-radius:12px;padding:clamp(16px,3vw,32px);margin:20px auto;max-width:1030px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;overflow-x:auto}
.docreader h1,.docreader h2,.docreader h3{line-height:1.3;margin:23px 0 9px;scroll-margin-top:80px}
.docreader p{margin:7px 0!important;line-height:1.65!important;max-width:100%!important;font-size:14.5px!important}
.docreader ul,.docreader ol{margin:10px 0;padding-left:20px}
.docreader .title{font-size:24px!important;font-weight:700!important;line-height:1.25!important}
.docreader .subtitle{font-size:13px!important;color:#667!important;margin:8px 0 18px!important}
.docreader img{display:block;max-width:100%!important;width:auto!important;height:auto!important;margin:18px auto}
.docreader table{border-collapse:collapse;width:max-content;max-width:100%;display:block;overflow-x:auto;font-size:13.5px}
.docreader td,.docreader th{border:1px solid #ccd8db;padding:8px}
.docreader a{word-break:break-all}
.offline-flag{display:inline-block;margin:0 0 10px;font-size:12px;color:#526d73;background:#edf4f4;border-radius:7px;padding:6px 10px}
.editor-link{border:1px solid #cfd9dc;background:#fff;padding:9px 13px;border-radius:9px;text-decoration:none;color:#174b54;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;display:inline-flex;gap:7px}
.reader-toolbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:15px 0}
@media(max-width:600px){.docreader{padding:14px!important}.docreader p{font-size:14px!important}.docreader h1{font-size:20px!important}}
</style><style id="portal-v004-styles">
.teaching-note{background:#f6f8f9;border:1px solid #c3d0d2;border-left:4px solid #174b54;border-radius:9px;margin:14px 0 12px;padding:14px 16px}.teaching-label{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;color:#24535d;letter-spacing:.3px;margin-bottom:7px}.teaching-note p{margin:9px 0!important}.original-pending{border-left:3px solid #e2e7e9;padding:8px 12px;background:#fafbfc;margin:8px 0;color:#68747a;font-size:12px}.original-pending summary{cursor:pointer}.search-match{background:#fff2c3!important;outline:2px solid #be9b3b;outline-offset:4px;scroll-margin-top:110px}.reader-index{border:1px solid #c5d4d6;border-radius:10px;background:white;padding:11px 14px;margin:18px 0}.reader-index summary{font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}.reader-index-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-top:13px}.reader-index-links .btn{font-size:12px;text-align:left}.technical-scheme svg{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;max-height:400px;margin:12px auto;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce3e7}.docreader p,.docreader h1,.docreader h2,.docreader h3{scroll-margin-top:100px}.docreader > p.title,.docreader > p.subtitle{display:none}.docreader h1{font-size:19px!important}.docreader h2{font-size:17px!important}.docreader h1 span,.docreader h2 span{font-size:inherit!important}.chapter .btn{flex-shrink:0;margin-left:8px}.chapter small{display:block;max-width:700px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}@media(max-width:650px){.chapter{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}.chapter .btn{margin-left:0}.technical-scheme svg{width:100%}}
</style><style id="portal-v005-styles">
/* Preservação dos textos originais; melhorias só na projeção de consulta */
.docreader{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif!important;font-size:15px;line-height:1.69;color:#17252b;overflow-wrap:break-word!important;overflow-x:auto!important;}
.docreader p{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.7!important;margin:10px 0!important;letter-spacing:normal!important;text-align:left!important;}
.docreader > p.title,.docreader > p.subtitle{display:none!important}
.docreader h1,.docreader h2,.docreader h3{font-family:inherit!important;font-weight:780!important;color:#182e36!important;letter-spacing:-.02em!important;line-height:1.27!important;page-break-after:avoid;}
.docreader h1{font-size:21px!important;border-bottom:2px solid #dce6e6;padding:17px 0 10px!important;margin:27px 0 12px!important}
.docreader h2{font-size:18px!important;margin:23px 0 11px!important;border-bottom:1px solid #e9efef;padding:6px 0 7px!important}
.docreader h3{font-size:16px!important;margin:18px 0 8px!important}
.docreader h1 *, .docreader h2 *, .docreader h3 *{font-size:inherit!important;font-weight:780!important;font-family:inherit!important;color:inherit!important}
.docreader span,.docreader li,.docreader td{font-family:inherit!important;font-size:inherit!important;line-height:inherit!important}
.docreader .reader-bold{font-weight:750!important}.docreader .reader-italic{font-style:italic!important}.docreader .reader-underlined{text-decoration:underline!important}
.docreader a{overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-word}
.docreader table{display:block!important;width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;overflow-x:auto!important;border-collapse:collapse;margin:14px 0 19px;font-size:14px!important}
.docreader table td,.docreader table th{border:1px solid #c8d4d5;padding:9px 11px!important;vertical-align:top;min-width:66px;line-height:1.48!important}
.docreader table tr:first-child{background:#edf2f2;font-weight:700}
.docreader .formula-line,.source-details .formula-line{display:block;max-width:100%;margin:12px 0!important;padding:11px 13px!important;background:#f5f7f8!important;border-left:4px solid #506974!important;border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;color:#1e323b!important;font:600 14px/1.7 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,"DejaVu Sans Mono",monospace!important;overflow-x:auto!important;overflow-wrap:break-word!important;white-space:pre-wrap}
.docreader sup,.docreader sub{font-size:0.78em!important;line-height:0!important}
.docreader .source-overview{padding:11px 15px;background:#f3f8f7;border-left:4px solid #365e63;border-radius:7px;color:#315057;font-size:13px!important}
.docreader details.source-details{margin:8px 0 18px;background:#f9fbfb;border:1px solid #cfdddd;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden}
.docreader details.source-details > summary{cursor:pointer;padding:13px 15px;font-weight:750;color:#21424a;line-height:1.35;list-style-position:inside;background:#f1f5f4}
.docreader details.source-details[open] > summary{border-bottom:1px solid #d6e1e0}
.docreader .source-details-body{padding:12px 14px}
.docreader .source-stat{font-size:12px;color:#51676e;font-weight:500;margin-left:6px}
.docreader .source-unit{border-left:3px solid #a9bdc0;padding:11px 13px;margin:9px 0;background:white;border-radius:4px 7px 7px 4px}
.docreader .source-unit p{margin:5px 0!important}.docreader .source-unit small{font-size:12px;color:#54666d}
.docreader .source-card{background:white;border:1px solid #e0e7e7;margin:9px 0;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden}
.docreader .source-card summary{cursor:pointer;display:list-item;list-style-position:inside;padding:11px 13px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.48}
.docreader .source-card[open] summary{border-bottom:1px solid #edf1f1}
.docreader .source-card-body{padding:11px 14px}
.docreader .source-card-body p{margin:6px 0!important;font-size:14px!important}
.docreader .source-card-body .answer-source{padding:10px 12px;background:#f0f5f4;border-left:3px solid #365e63;border-radius:4px;white-space:pre-wrap}
.docreader .source-subhead{margin:13px 0 5px!important;font-size:13px!important;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;color:#4b656c}
.docreader .editing-note{font-size:12px!important;color:#53686d!important;margin:9px 0!important}
.docreader .original-question{border-top:1px dashed #dce6e6;padding-top:9px;color:#5b656a;font-size:12px!important}
.editorial-badge{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;color:#735323;background:#fff4de;border:1px solid #e8cf9b;border-radius:6px;padding:2px 6px;margin-left:6px}
.image-rejected{border:2px dashed #9c642d!important;background:#fffaf3!important}
.image-rejected .icText{background:#fff7e8}
.image-warning{padding:9px 11px;background:#fff1e4;border:1px solid #e5c2a0;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;color:#774a28;margin:10px 0}
.docreader .technical-scheme svg{max-height:none!important}
.docreader .original-pending{color:#54646b!important;font-size:12px!important}
.reader-note{color:#4d646b;font-size:13px;padding:10px 13px;background:#f3f6f6;border-radius:9px;margin:12px 0}
@media(max-width:650px){.docreader{padding:13px!important;font-size:14px!important}.docreader p{font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.65!important}.docreader h1{font-size:19px!important}.docreader h2{font-size:17px!important}.docreader .source-details-body{padding:9px}.docreader .source-card summary{padding:11px 8px}.docreader .formula-line,.source-details .formula-line{font-size:13px!important;padding:9px 10px!important}}
@media print{.header,.sidebar,.reader-toolbar{display:none!important}.wrap{display:block}.main{padding:0!important}.docreader{border:0!important;max-width:none!important}.docreader details.source-details:not([open]){display:none}}

.edition-note{background:#fffaf0;border-left:4px solid #b88636;border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;padding:10px 12px;margin:10px 0;color:#634d2b;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55}
.edition-note strong{color:#533d1a}.edition-note a{font-size:12px}
.image-audit-small{font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;color:#66532e;background:#fff8e9;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:7px;margin:8px 0}

.image-alias-badge{display:inline-block;border:1px solid #b8c4c5;background:#f2f5f5;color:#3d5359;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;margin:6px 0}
.v006-topic-tools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:14px 0 20px}

</style><style id="v007-approved-styles">.v006-block{margin:18px 0 25px;max-width:1000px}.v006-block h2{margin:6px 0 16px}.v006-block .src-text{margin:10px 0;white-space:pre-wrap}.v006-evolution{margin:14px 0;background:#f5f8f9;border-left:4px solid #174b54;padding:13px;border-radius:5px}.v006-evolution p{margin:9px 0}.v006-evolution .answer-source{white-space:pre-wrap;background:#eaf2f1;padding:10px;border-radius:6px}.v006-block .fc{min-height:0}</style><style>.notice-public{padding:9px 18px;background:#f9f4e7;color:#745223;text-align:center;font-size:13px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee2bf}.mns-panel,[data-route="manuscript"]{display:none!important}</style></head><body>

Complementa&ccedil;&atilde;o did&aacute;tica baseada nos cart&otilde;es CARD-1299 a CARD-1303 da F17. N&atilde;o substitui gabaritos, normas t&eacute;cnicas nem verifica&ccedil;&otilde;es de projeto.</span></p><h1 id="h.a6axu0m3grql" style="padding-top:20pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:20pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:18pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">1. MAPA DOS CONCEITOS E SUAS RELA&Ccedil;&Otilde;ES</span></h1><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Caminho para resolver problemas de vigas</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">GEOMETRIA (L, b, h) + MATERIAL (&gamma;, E) &rarr; CARREGAMENTO (q, Q) &rarr; EQUIL&Iacute;BRIO GLOBAL (R_A, R_B) &rarr; CORTE DE SE&Ccedil;&Atilde;O (V, M) &rarr; TENS&Atilde;O DE FLEX&Atilde;O (&sigma; = M/W) &rarr; DESLOCAMENTOS (relacionados &agrave; rigidez EI).</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">A ordem evita misturar grandezas f&iacute;sicas diferentes. Uma tens&atilde;o n&atilde;o &eacute; uma for&ccedil;a; um momento n&atilde;o &eacute; uma carga linear; um deslocamento n&atilde;o &eacute; um momento.</span></p><h2 id="h.2ruqtsh0bqwt" style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:16pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Grandezas que n&atilde;o podem ser confundidas</span></h2><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">&bull; q &mdash; intensidade de carga distribu&iacute;da [kN/m]. &nbsp; &bull; Q ou P &mdash; carga concentrada [kN].</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">&bull; R_A e R_B &mdash; rea&ccedil;&otilde;es verticais de apoio [kN]. &nbsp; &bull; V &mdash; esfor&ccedil;o cortante interno [kN].</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">&bull; M &mdash; momento fletor interno [kN&middot;m]. &nbsp; &bull; &sigma; &mdash; tens&atilde;o normal de flex&atilde;o [MPa = N/mm&sup2;].</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">&bull; W = I/c &mdash; m&oacute;dulo resistente da se&ccedil;&atilde;o [m&sup3; ou mm&sup3;]. &nbsp; &bull; EI &mdash; rigidez &agrave; flex&atilde;o [for&ccedil;a &times; comprimento&sup2;].</span></p><h1 id="h.qbbzf46jk9yd" style="padding-top:20pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:20pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:18pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">2. DAS DIMENS&Otilde;ES DA VIGA &Agrave; CARGA LINEAR</span></h1><h2 id="h.gcq0xf478wer" style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:16pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Peso pr&oacute;prio n&atilde;o &eacute; carga concentrada</span></h2><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Quando o peso espec&iacute;fico &gamma; est&aacute; expresso em kN/m&sup3; e a se&ccedil;&atilde;o &eacute; constante, a carga distribu&iacute;da de peso pr&oacute;prio resulta de q = &gamma; &times; A, com A = b &times; h para uma se&ccedil;&atilde;o retangular.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Exemplo da F17 (CARD-1301): b = 0,20 m; h = 0,50 m; &gamma; = 25 kN/m&sup3;.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">q = 25 &times; (0,20 &times; 0,50) = 2,50 kN/m.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Confer&ecirc;ncia de unidade: (kN/m&sup3;) &times; (m&sup2;) = kN/m. A unidade confirma que o resultado &eacute; uma carga por comprimento, n&atilde;o uma for&ccedil;a &uacute;nica.</span></p><h2 id="h.6d90m2juh3vq" style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:16pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Como desenhar o diagrama de corpo livre</span></h2><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">1) Desenhar o v&atilde;o L e os tipos de apoio. 2) Representar q por setas distribu&iacute;das e Q por uma seta concentrada. 3) Substituir os apoios pelas rea&ccedil;&otilde;es compat&iacute;veis. 4) Aplicar &Sigma;F_y = 0 e &Sigma;M = 0 antes de seccionar.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Para q uniforme ao longo de todo o v&atilde;o, a resultante equivalente vale qL e age no centro do trecho carregado. Essa substitui&ccedil;&atilde;o &eacute; &uacute;til para calcular as rea&ccedil;&otilde;es, mas n&atilde;o elimina o carregamento distribu&iacute;do quando se formula V(x) ou M(x) no interior da viga.</span></p><h1 id="h.sfpfd7mkny5x" style="padding-top:20pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:20pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:18pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">3. APOIOS E EQUIL&Iacute;BRIO GLOBAL</span></h1><h2 id="h.i5xgqekwipgh" style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:16pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Viga biapoiada com q uniforme</span></h2><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Em uma viga simplesmente apoiada, com carga q uniformemente distribu&iacute;da em todo L e sem outras a&ccedil;&otilde;es verticais, a simetria d&aacute; R_A = R_B = qL/2.</span></p><h2 id="h.15tmqhs0psw5" style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:16pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Com carga concentrada Q posicionada em P</span></h2><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Adote a dist&acirc;ncia de P at&eacute; B igual a x. Ent&atilde;o, a dist&acirc;ncia de A at&eacute; P &eacute; L &minus; x.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">R_A = qL/2 + Qx/L &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; e &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; R_B = qL/2 + Q(L &minus; x)/L.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Essas express&otilde;es seguem de &Sigma;M_B = 0, &Sigma;M_A = 0 e &Sigma;F_y = 0. N&atilde;o confundir a dist&acirc;ncia at&eacute; o apoio oposto com a dist&acirc;ncia medida desde o apoio da rea&ccedil;&atilde;o.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Para L = 4 m e q = 2,5 kN/m: R_A = 5 + Qx/4 e R_B = 5 + Q(4 &minus; x)/4, em kN.</span></p><h1 id="h.bs3rpm2otpco" style="padding-top:20pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:20pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:18pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">4. O CORTE DA SE&Ccedil;&Atilde;O REVELA V E M</span></h1><h2 id="h.c9adz8n1m1x2" style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:16pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Por que se corta a viga?</span></h2><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Ap&oacute;s obter as rea&ccedil;&otilde;es globais, imagine um corte na se&ccedil;&atilde;o P. Isole o segmento esquerdo ou direito e represente as a&ccedil;&otilde;es internas de corte (V_P) e flex&atilde;o (M_P). O equil&iacute;brio do segmento determina as inc&oacute;gnitas internas.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Essa &eacute; a ideia fundamental do CARD-1303: rea&ccedil;&otilde;es com o corpo inteiro; esfor&ccedil;os internos com um dos segmentos cortados. Mantenha a mesma conven&ccedil;&atilde;o de sinais ao trocar de lado.</span></p><h2 id="h.benmn7hsn7xb" style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:16pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Rela&ccedil;&otilde;es gerais entre carga, cortante e momento</span></h2><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Sob a conven&ccedil;&atilde;o usual de sinais: dV/dx = &minus;q(x) e dM/dx = V(x).</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Isso significa: carga distribu&iacute;da constante &rarr; cortante varia linearmente &rarr; momento varia quadraticamente. Onde V passa de positivo para negativo e M &eacute; cont&iacute;nuo, costuma ocorrer um m&aacute;ximo local de momento.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Uma carga concentrada vertical Q provoca um salto no diagrama de V, com magnitude Q. O momento M permanece cont&iacute;nuo na se&ccedil;&atilde;o dessa carga, desde que ali n&atilde;o exista um momento concentrado aplicado.</span></p><h2 id="h.lh3afmu7shu9" style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:16pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Salto de cortante na carga concentrada</span></h2><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Para o trecho da figura, antes de P: V_P&minus; = R_A &minus; q(L &minus; x). Imediatamente depois de P: V_P+ = R_A &minus; q(L &minus; x) &minus; Q.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">&Delta;V = V_P+ &minus; V_P&minus; = &minus;Q; portanto |&Delta;V| = Q.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">PEGADINHA: uma for&ccedil;a concentrada altera V abruptamente; um momento concentrado altera o diagrama M por um salto. N&atilde;o trocar os dois efeitos.</span></p><h1 id="h.9pesnixfxoma" style="padding-top:20pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:20pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:18pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">5. MOMENTO M&Aacute;XIMO E SUA POSI&Ccedil;&Atilde;O</span></h1><h2 id="h.f5dlg12b5ok5" style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:16pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Apenas q uniforme, em viga biapoiada</span></h2><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">M_max = qL&sup2;/8 (no meio do v&atilde;o).</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">O gr&aacute;fico de M &eacute; uma par&aacute;bola, e o de V &eacute; uma reta. O momento m&aacute;ximo ocorre no ponto em que V = 0, dentro das condi&ccedil;&otilde;es apresentadas.</span></p><h2 id="h.54gc5s1t9fd3" style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:16pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">q uniforme com for&ccedil;a m&oacute;vel Q aplicada em P</span></h2><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Quando o ponto de avalia&ccedil;&atilde;o coincide com a posi&ccedil;&atilde;o vari&aacute;vel da for&ccedil;a Q e x representa a dist&acirc;ncia P&ndash;B, o equil&iacute;brio fornece:</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">M_P(x) = [q/2 + Q/L] &times; x(L &minus; x), em kN&middot;m quando as unidades s&atilde;o coerentes.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Como x(L&minus;x) &eacute; uma par&aacute;bola c&ocirc;ncava para baixo, seu m&aacute;ximo ocorre em x = L/2. Assim:</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">M_P,m&aacute;x = qL&sup2;/8 + QL/4.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Para L=4 m e q=2,5 kN/m: M_P,m&aacute;x = 5 + Q (em kN&middot;m, com Q expresso em kN e L=4 m). A express&atilde;o resulta da mesma condi&ccedil;&atilde;o representada no exemplo visual da F17.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">ATEN&Ccedil;&Atilde;O: essa posi&ccedil;&atilde;o m&aacute;xima vale para o modelo descrito, em que a for&ccedil;a Q se desloca junto com P. Se a carga concentrada estiver fixa numa posi&ccedil;&atilde;o n&atilde;o central, deve-se calcular o momento segundo a posi&ccedil;&atilde;o fixa e o trecho analisado.</span></p><h2 id="h.av2a21ddvmo0" style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:16pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">M&aacute;ximo por derivada ou v&eacute;rtice</span></h2><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">No CARD-1302, a fun&ccedil;&atilde;o do tipo M(x) = K x(L&minus;x), com K&gt;0, pode ser reescrita M(x) = &minus;Kx&sup2; + KLx. Derivando: M&prime;(x) = K(L&minus;2x). Da condi&ccedil;&atilde;o M&prime; = 0: x = L/2; ent&atilde;o M_m&aacute;x = KL&sup2;/4.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Macete: K positivo + par&aacute;bola para baixo &rarr; m&aacute;ximo no meio.</span></p><h1 id="h.xm666keakf61" style="padding-top:20pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:20pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:18pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">6. DO MOMENTO &Agrave; TENS&Atilde;O DE FLEX&Atilde;O</span></h1><h2 id="h.m32fk0rlgw3l" style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:16pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Diferen&ccedil;a f&iacute;sica entre M e &sigma;</span></h2><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">M &eacute; solicita&ccedil;&atilde;o interna que tende a produzir flex&atilde;o; &sigma; &eacute; a intensidade de for&ccedil;a normal por &aacute;rea na se&ccedil;&atilde;o. Mesmo que uma quest&atilde;o apresente &sigma;_max, ainda &eacute; necess&aacute;rio encontrar o momento correspondente antes de determinar o carregamento.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Em flex&atilde;o simples el&aacute;stica: &sigma;_max = M/W, logo M = &sigma;_max W.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Para se&ccedil;&atilde;o retangular, I = b h&sup3;/12; a fibra extrema fica a c = h/2; portanto W = I/c = b h&sup2;/6. Pressup&otilde;e-se eixo e orienta&ccedil;&atilde;o correspondentes &agrave; flex&atilde;o analisada.</span></p><h2 id="h.97nx3vf9rxz5" style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:16pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Exemplo original CARD-1299 &mdash; racioc&iacute;nio em tr&ecirc;s passos</span></h2><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Dados: L = 6 m; b = 0,12 m; h = 0,40 m; &sigma;_max = 36 MPa. Considerar q uniformemente distribu&iacute;do em todo o v&atilde;o e comportamento compat&iacute;vel com flex&atilde;o simples el&aacute;stica.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Passo 1 &mdash; M&oacute;dulo resistente: W = b h&sup2;/6 = 0,12 &times; 0,40&sup2; / 6 = 0,0032 m&sup3;.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Passo 2 &mdash; Converter a tens&atilde;o: 36 MPa = 36.000 kN/m&sup2;. Ent&atilde;o M_max = &sigma;_max W = 36.000 &times; 0,0032 = 115,2 kN&middot;m.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Passo 3 &mdash; Determinar q: M_max = qL&sup2;/8 &rArr; q = 8M_max/L&sup2; = 8 &times; 115,2 / 36 = 25,6 kN/m.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Resultado F17: q = 25,6 kN/m.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Erro frequente: multiplicar MPa diretamente por W em m&sup3; sem converter unidades; o n&uacute;mero pode ficar errado por fator de mil ou de um milh&atilde;o.</span></p><h1 id="h.2wcaq2k9dtet" style="padding-top:20pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:20pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:18pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">7. QUADRO DE PEGADINHAS E MACETES</span></h1><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">&bull; &gamma; [kN/m&sup3;] &times; A [m&sup2;] &rarr; q [kN/m]. &nbsp;&bull; q &times; L &rarr; resultante [kN]. &nbsp;&bull; &Sigma;M e &Sigma;F &rarr; rea&ccedil;&otilde;es.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">&bull; Carga distribu&iacute;da constante: V &eacute; linear, M &eacute; parab&oacute;lico. &nbsp;&bull; For&ccedil;a concentrada: salto em V. &nbsp;&bull; Momento concentrado: salto em M.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">&bull; M [kN&middot;m] n&atilde;o &eacute; &sigma; [MPa]. &nbsp;&bull; W depende da geometria e do eixo de flex&atilde;o. &nbsp;&bull; Rea&ccedil;&otilde;es globais primeiro, corte da se&ccedil;&atilde;o depois.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Macete de sequ&ecirc;ncia: &gamma;A &rarr; q; &Sigma;F/&Sigma;M &rarr; R; corte &rarr; V/M; M/W &rarr; &sigma;.</span></p><h1 id="h.toz9tg5es4g" style="padding-top:20pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:20pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:18pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">8. MAPA DE CONEX&Otilde;ES ENTRE CONHECIMENTOS F17</span></h1><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">CARD-1301 / UNI-1307 &mdash; Peso pr&oacute;prio &rarr; q. &nbsp;CARD-1303 / UNI-1309 &mdash; Rea&ccedil;&otilde;es e corte de se&ccedil;&atilde;o.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">CARD-1302 / UNI-1308 &mdash; Fun&ccedil;&atilde;o quadr&aacute;tica e m&aacute;ximo de momento. &nbsp;CARD-1300 / UNI-1306 &mdash; Diferen&ccedil;a entre momento e tens&atilde;o.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">CARD-1299 / UNI-1305 &mdash; C&aacute;lculo integrando geometria, M, &sigma; e q.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">Essas liga&ccedil;&otilde;es servem para estudo e cobertura conceitual: n&atilde;o representam revis&atilde;o SRS autom&aacute;tica dos cart&otilde;es relacionados.</span></p><h1 id="h.yyn02x733jzt" style="padding-top:20pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:20pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.15;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:18pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">9. PRANCHAS VISUAIS RELACIONADAS &mdash; CONFER&Ecirc;NCIA PENDENTE</span></h1><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;font-style:normal">FIGURA 1 &mdash; Momento m&aacute;ximo com peso pr&oacute;prio e carga concentrada m&oacute;vel. Conferida quanto ao encadeamento b&aacute;sico das equa&ccedil;&otilde;es apresentadas, mas a vers&atilde;o aprovada e qualquer requisito normativo ainda precisam ser validados.</span></p><p style="padding:0;margin:0;color:#000000;font-size:11pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;;line-height:1.15;orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left"><span style="overflow: hidden; display: inline-block; margin: 0.00px 0.00px; border: 0.00px solid #000000; transform: rotate(0.00rad) translateZ(0px); -webkit-transform: rotate(0.00rad) translateZ(0px); width: 519.40px; height: 474.67px;"><img alt="" src="data:image/png;base64,
